messages:
maria (oncall): noticing a spike in SSE disconnects for eu-west around 09:06 UTC. multiple customers reporting partial streams and reconnect loops :frowning:
maria (oncall): example from support ticket #5421 — client sees two partial events then connection drops, they call it 'half responses'
jessie (cs): escalated from CS this morning, customer says restart doesn't help, they see repeated reconnect attempts from our SDK. they want ETA and workaround
oncall-bot: paging oncall rotations: @maria (oncall) @alex (infra) — incident created: INC-20260315-001
maria (oncall): assigning to infra and runtime. @alex can you confirm if any infra changes in eu-west in the last hour?
alex (infra): no infra deploys, no config churn. I'm seeing increased 5xx on the sse-proxy pool in eu-west-1 behind the LB. hit counts start ~1784506700
sanjeev (eng-runtime): jumping in — runrate of partial outputs usually means KV cache mismatch or worker OOM/evictions. pulling logs for sse-worker processes now
sanjeev (eng-runtime): tail from router shows a lot of `client disconnected` followed by `incomplete stream: last token index mismatch` — looks like stream framing errors at the runtime layer
alex (infra): LB logs show some backend 504/502 to the runtime pods during the window. no network-level packet loss from VPC metrics
maria (oncall): customers reporting 100–200ms higher latency before disconnects. several are on our hosted API with SDK streaming enabled
jessie (cs): customer B (large embedder) threatens to failover to another vendor if not resolved in 2 hours. need clear mitigation and customer note
sanjeev (eng-runtime): quick mitigation: enabling fallback routing to non-streaming endpoint (polling) for affected routes. will also spin up extra streaming worker pods in eu-west with a different kernel build to avoid the suspected kv-cache bug
alex (infra): doing that now: scaling sse-worker eu-west +40% and toggling health-check to be more permissive for graceful reconnections
oncall-bot: action: scale sse-worker eu-west count=+8 initiated by alex (infra)
alex (infra): scale completed in ~45s. new pods registered, LB draining old ones
sanjeev (eng-runtime): also flipping feature-flag `sse_kv_cache_v2=false` for eu-west to force legacy cache behavior while we investigate. doing canary for 10% of tenants then 100% if green
maria (oncall): good. @jessie please update the customers about temporary polling fallback and note we expect reduced partials while we stabilize
jessie (cs): will do. drafting message: "We're seeing partial streaming interruptions in eu-west. Temporary workaround: switch to polling or enable SDK auto-retry. We're scaling workers and routing affected traffic to a fallback. ETA 30-60m." pls review
sanjeev (eng-runtime): logs from one of the failing pods:
```
2026-03-15T09:08:12.345Z runtime[pid=2345] WARN stream: client disconnected: EOF
2026-03-15T09:08:12.346Z runtime[pid=2345] ERROR stream: incomplete frame: expected seq 1024 got 1020
2026-03-15T09:08:12.347Z runtime[pid=2345] INFO conn: reconnect_attempt scheduled=150ms
```
sanjeev (eng-runtime): correlating with kernel build id `kbuild-1.2.7-rt` — older kernels are fine, suspect regression in kbuild-1.2.8 we rolled last week for perf
alex (infra): verified: 1.2.8 landed on a subset of eu-west nodes at 08:50 UTC. I'm starting a limited rollback to 1.2.7 on the node group running sse-worker
maria (oncall): rollback note: do it gradually to avoid synchronized restarts. prefer cordon+drain with session-preserve annotation
alex (infra): cordon+drain done for 3 nodes, new pods scheduled on 1.2.7 nodes. LB health improving
oncall-bot: note: rollback job alex (infra) -> nodegroup-sse-eu-west started
jessie (cs): customer B acknowledged workaround, asked for status page update and a short email once stabilized
maria (oncall): will update status page once we see error rates drop below 0.5% for 10m. can someone instrument a short-lived metric for partial-stream events?
sanjeev (eng-runtime): added `stream.partial_events` counter and grafana panel. initial spike peaked at 420/min, now down to 38/min after scale+rollback
maria (oncall): that's promising. last 5m p50 latency trending back to normal
alex (infra): LB 502s decreased 80% after rollback and worker scale. still a few lingering sessions failing during reconnect attempts
sanjeev (eng-runtime): implementing graceful reconnection fix: increase `stream.reconnect_window_ms` from 150 -> 300 for eu-west so clients have longer to resume KV sync. will roll in next 2m
maria (oncall): is there any risk this increases cost substantially? need to note to execs if it does
sanjeev (eng-runtime): small increase in kept-alive slots but we have headroom for the hour. still cheaper than customer churn :grimacing:
jessie (cs): customer B on conference call now, passed along the workaround and timeline. they accepted fallback to polling temporarily. asked for log snippet for their devs to show it's a client-side recommended config change
sanjeev (eng-runtime): suggested client-side change: set `sse.reconnect_policy: aggressive` with exponential backoff and enable `preserve_kv_cache: true` in SDK v2.1.3. sample:
```
sdk.configure({
  streaming: true,
  sse: { reconnect_policy: 'aggressive', preserve_kv_cache: true }
})
```
jessie (cs): sending that to customer B now
maria (oncall): status update draft: "We've detected streaming interruptions in EU-WEST caused by an interaction between a recent kernel build and runtime KV cache behavior. Impact: partial outputs/disconnects for streaming requests. Mitigation: scaled workers, rollback of kernel on affected nodes, temporary routing to polling endpoints, and increased reconnect window. Service is stabilizing."
statusbot: scheduled status page update at 09:25 UTC by maria (oncall)
maria (oncall): would like eng-runtime to follow up with a postmortem and a plan to add model-level graceful degrade (fallback-model routing) so streaming clients get a shorter but complete response rather than partial fragments
sanjeev (eng-runtime): agreed — adding fallback-model routing to roadmap. short-term we already enabled non-streaming fallback per-tenant via routing policy: `route.if(streaming.errors>3).to(polling-v1)`
alex (infra): final numbers: peak partial_events=420/min, peak 502s=65/min, impacted tenants ~18 (mostly EU customers), rollback and scale reduced errors to 12/min within 22m
maria (oncall): good work. leaving incident open for 2h for monitoring. tagging postmortem owners: @sanjeev + @alex. @jessie keep CS looped for customer updates
cs-escalations: noted — keeping customer contacts ready for additional follow-ups
maria (oncall): closing update for now. will postpostmortem link here when available. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: incident INC-20260315-001 status -> monitoring (open)
